meta.title: Latest counter offer rank displayed correctly in Responses list
gaps: Attempting to accept the same already accepted counter offer a second time and verifying the resulting refusal message
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Attempting to accept the same already accepted counter offer a second time and verifying the resulting refusal message

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with an existing vendor bid.
Reach the buyer comparison grid, which is required before sending a counter offer.
Send a counter offer to the prepared vendor bid.
Act as Vendor A in the supplier portal.
Open the event overview where the pending counter offer is available.
Accept the counter offer once to establish the already-accepted state.
Return to the buyer console to verify the acceptance.
Assert that the buyer grid marks Vendor A's counter offer as accepted.
Return to Vendor A's supplier portal for the second-attempt scenario.
Reopen the event overview containing the already accepted counter offer.

args.need: attempt to click Accept a second time on the already accepted counter offer as Vendor A and report the refusal message

steps.note: The catalog has no step for attempting a second acceptance on an already accepted counter offer.
Assert that the second acceptance attempt produced an error toast.
